newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta's trade deficit widens 5.5 pct in Jan-Sept.
newsitem.headline: Malta's trade deficit widens 5.5 pct in Jan-Sept.

text.p: Malta's trade gap widened by 5.5 percent in the first nine months of this year as exports fell more sharply than imports, the Central Office of Statistics said on Tuesday.
MALTESE TRADE(million Maltese lira) Jan-Sept 96 Jan-Sept 95
Domestic exports fell Lm 29.4 million to Lm 416.7 million, but this fall was offset by re-exports which rose to Lm 41.7 million from Lm 33.6 million, the office said.
A Lm 4.8 million rise in consumer goods imports was offset by falls in imports of industrial supplies, capital and other goods.
